SUB_TITLE.HERO: I build modern, high-performance web and mobile applications with a strong focus on user experience, scalability, and clean architecture. As a full-stack developer, I develop robust front-end interfaces with React and scalable backend systems using Node.js and NestJS.
ABOUT_ME: I am a full-stack developer with a strong engineering background, building modern, scalable, and production-ready applications. I specialize in React, TypeScript, and Next.js, creating clean, maintainable interfaces with a reusable component architecture and strong attention to performance and user experience.

On the backend, I develop robust APIs and server-side systems using Node.js and NestJS, implementing structured architectures, authentication flows, and database integrations. I work with PostgreSQL, Supabase, and Firebase, building secure REST APIs and scalable backend services that power modern applications.
I also develop cross-platform mobile applications using React Native, extending web products into mobile environments with consistent architecture and shared development practices.

I am committed to continuous learning and performance-driven development. I actively collaborate within teams using Git-based workflows, contributing through structured commits, pull requests, and code reviews to ensure clean, maintainable, and reliable production outcomes.

paradiseHotel.title: The Paradise Hotel
paradiseHotel.description:
A production-grade full-stack hotel booking platform built with Next.js 16, React 19, and TypeScript, featuring secure authentication, transactional booking logic, internationalization, email workflows, and a fully responsive modern UI.

This project demonstrates real-world SaaS architecture with race-condition-safe booking creation, advanced middleware-based route protection, and enterprise-level error handling.

travelRoute.title: Travel Route
travelRoute.description:
Travel Route a fully responsive travel planning app to help you organize your travel experiences, manage todos, and explore cities around the world.

A fully responsive travel planning app built with React, Vite, and TypeScript. Plan your trips by adding cities on an interactive map, manage to-dos, favorite your places, and track your travel history
